import heapq
import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    arr = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    
    # Create a min heap (priority queue)
    heapq.heapify(arr)
    
    median_index = n // 2
    
    # Pop elements until we reach the median
    for _ in range(median_index):
        heapq.heappop(arr)
    
    print(arr[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
